summary.en: When the person wants to see or use something on their own computer: any web address (page, video, map, document, mail, service) or installed app. Opens the exact address in THEIR browser, starts apps, raises or closes windows. No clicking around.
summary.ru: Когда пользователь хочет сам что-то увидеть или использовать: любой веб-адрес (страница, видео, карта, документ, почта, сервис) или установленное приложение. Открывает точный адрес в ЕГО браузере, запускает приложения, выводит вперёд и закрывает окна. Без кликов по страницам.

required.name: host.open
required.reason: to open web addresses in your own browser, where you are signed in, and to start applications you have installed

required.name: host.windows
required.reason: to see your open windows (their titles can show what you are reading), bring one to the front, and close one only after asking you

tools.name: open_url
tools.summary: Open an http(s) address in a new tab of the person's own browser and return at once. This is the way to show the person any page: a site, a search or map page, a document, one exact video; nothing is read back from the page.

url.description: A full http or https address, without a login inside it.

tools.name: open_app
tools.summary: Start an installed application by its name (for example "Telegram" or "Firefox"). Only applications that have a desktop entry can be started; an ambiguous name is answered with the candidates.

tools.name: windows
tools.summary: List the person's open windows: id, application, title, workspace and which one has focus. A browser window's title is its active tab's title.

tools.name: focus
tools.summary: Bring a window to the front, by the id from windows.

tools.name: close
tools.summary: Close a window, by the id from windows. The person is asked first and may refuse. Closing a browser window closes every tab in it.
